name: genudo
description: Genudo — the platform to build AI agents for any communication or sequence-based channel. Pipeline-aware agents with integration capabilities and company-knowledge access, managed from one platform, one inbox, and one analytics dashboard. This plugin builds, edits, automates, and analyzes them from Claude with 18 skills and 5 agents.
